# Late Checkout Travel

> Late Checkout Travel is a luxury travel advisor that reviews and manages refundable luxury hotel reservations and provides access to preferred partner rates and amenities at no additional cost to clients.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://latecheckouttravel.com/): Overview of the hotel reservation review and luxury travel advisory service.
- [About](https://latecheckouttravel.com/about.html): Company, compensation, accreditation, preferred partnerships, LinkedIn, and Travel Journal details.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://latecheckouttravel.com/faqs.html): Eligibility, rebooking, rates, benefits, and process.
- [Upgrade an existing stay](https://latecheckouttravel.com/upgrade/): Submit a refundable luxury hotel reservation for review.
- [Start a new stay](https://latecheckouttravel.com/start/): Request personalized luxury hotel booking options.
- [Contact](https://latecheckouttravel.com/contact.html): Contact Late Checkout Travel.

## Official profiles

- [Late Checkout Travel on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/late-checkout-travel)
- [Late Checkout Travel Journal on Substack](https://latecheckouttravel.substack.com/)

## Key facts

- Late Checkout Travel is a registered travel advisor operating under a valid IATA accreditation.
- It works with a global network of more than 8,200 hotels and travel providers.
- Eligible reservations may receive upgrades, daily breakfast, property credits, early check-in, late check-out, and on-property recognition, subject to availability.
- Hotels and travel providers pay commissions; clients do not pay service fees for standard hotel bookings.
- Existing reservations are never changed without client approval.

Contact: hello@latecheckouttravel.com
